title: Preserve score-scale invariance in `compare_evaluations`
body: ### Related Issues/PRs Relates to #26396 (the original paired-comparison API). ### What changes are proposed in this pull request? The constant-difference check uses an absolute tolerance of `1e-12`. A nonconstant set of paired scores becomes "constant" merely by expressing the same scores in smaller units. This collapses its bootstrap confidence interval to a point and replaces a finite paired t-test p-value and effect size with `NaN`. Keep the existing relative tolerance and set the absolute tolerance to zero. Genuine zero or constant differences retain their existing special handling. No test-selection thresholds or statistical formulas change. ### How is this PR tested? - [x] Existing unit/integration tests - [x] New unit/integration tests On base `e8a158349ec5ce27f715b8b1dd4a92dd7d409b8a`, the six new regression/control cases produce **2 failed, 4 passed**. With this change, the complete `tests/genai/evaluate/test_comparison.py` module passes: **55 passed**. It includes real evaluation runs, row pairing, logging, identical/constant differences, binary comparisons and statistical references. The new cases use exact binary rescaling to isolate the tolerance from decimal-rounding effects, with both zero and nonzero first differences. They compare the paired t-test and effect size to independent SciPy/formula references and verify the interval remains nondegenerate and scales with the units. Python 3.12.14, NumPy 2.5.4, SciPy 1.18.1. Changed-file Ruff 0.16.8, formatting, Clint, character normalization and `git diff --check` pass. The full pre-commit invocation was attempted but stops while initializing the unrelated Prettier environment because npm rejects its local git package with `EALLOWGIT`; the Python checks were run separately with the repository's pinned tools. The full repository suite was not run. ### Does this PR require documentation update? - [x] No. ### Does this PR require updating the [MLflow Skills](https://github.com/mlflow/skills) repository? - [x] No. ### Release Notes #### Is this a user-facing change? - [x] Yes. `compare_evaluations` preserves confidence intervals, paired t-test results and effect sizes for nonconstant scores expressed in small units. #### What component(s), interfaces, languages, and integrations does this PR affect? Components - [x] `area/evaluation`: MLflow model evaluation features, evaluation metrics, and evaluation workflows #### How should the PR be classified in the release notes? Choose one: - [x] `rn/bug-fix` - A user-facing bug fix worth mentioning in the release notes #### Is this PR a critical bugfix or security fix that should go into the next patch release? - [ ] This PR is critical and needs to be in the next patch release - [x] This PR can wait for the next minor release
